title: Diwali Bonus Tax: What Salaried Employees Need to Know
description: A Diwali bonus received from your employer is fully taxable as part of your salary income. This bonus is added to your total income and taxed at your applicab.

faq.q: Is a Diwali bonus always taxable?
faq.a: Yes, a cash Diwali bonus received from your employer is always considered part of your salary income and is fully taxable as per your applicable income tax slab rates.

faq.q: Does my employer deduct TDS on the Diwali bonus?
faq.a: Yes, your employer is legally obligated to deduct Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on your Diwali bonus, just like your regular salary. They will adjust the TDS for the remaining months of the financial year.

faq.q: Can I claim any exemptions on my Diwali bonus?
faq.a:
No, a cash Diwali bonus from an employer is fully taxable as salary and does not qualify for any specific exemptions under the "gifts" section of the Income Tax Act.

Will a Diwali bonus affect my tax slab?

A Diwali bonus is added to your total annual income. If this increased income pushes you into a higher tax bracket, or increases the portion of your income taxed at a higher rate, then yes, it will affect your overall tax liability.

faq.q: How do I report my Diwali bonus in my Income Tax Return (ITR)?
faq.a: You don't report it separately. Your employer will include the bonus in your consolidated salary income in Form 16. You simply declare the total salary figure as provided in your Form 16 when filing your ITR.
